description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans silo configurations, grain placement strategies, and grain resolution merging, including setup of test clusters, configuration of silos and clients, and various test cases for grain exclusion and placement.

classes.name: HeterogeneousTests
classes.description: Contains tests for heterogeneous silo configurations, grain exclusion, and grain resolver merging in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options, including message options, type management, and grain type blocklisting.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client options, specifically the type management refresh interval.

methods.name: SetupAndDeployCluster
methods.description: Sets up and deploys a test Orleans cluster with specified placement strategy and blacklisted grain types.

methods.name: GrainExcludedTest
methods.description: Tests that grain exclusion via blocklisting works as expected.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTests
methods.description: Tests for grain resolver merging with different placement strategies.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverWithClientRefreshTests
methods.description: Tests for grain resolver merging with client refresh scenarios.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerPlacementTests
methods.description: Tests for stateless worker grain placement strategies.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerPlacementWithClientRefreshTests
methods.description: Tests for stateless worker placement with client refresh, skipped due to known issue.

methods.name: CallITestGrainMethod
methods.description: Calls a method on ITestGrain to set a label.

methods.name: CallIStatelessWorkerGrainMethod
methods.description: Calls a method on IStatelessWorkerGrain to get call stats.

methods.name: MergeGrainResolverTestsImpl
methods.description: Implementation of the grain resolver merging tests, including cluster setup, silo addition/removal, and validation.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test class, stopping silos and cleaning up.
